mixing_order_reasoning: From Chemistry Plan: TBHP/NaBr/H2SO4 mixed with alcohol first to generate acyl intermediate; morpholine added downstream to avoid oxidation of amine.
pre_reactor_steps: Degas dioxane solvent if necessary (though Chemistry Plan states deoxygenation not required, standard practice for peroxide reactions).
post_reactor_steps: Collect product. No quench specified in Chemistry Plan.
chemistry_notes: Two-stage oxidative amidation. Stage 1 (5 mL) oxidizes benzyl alcohol to benzoyl intermediate using TBHP/NaBr/H2SO4. Stage 2 (10 mL) amidates with morpholine added via interstage pump. TBHP and morpholine are incompatible and must be segregated. Reaction is thermal (80°C), no light required. PFA tubing used for thermal stability. BPR set to 5 bar as precautionary measure due to operating temperature (80°C) being within 30°C of dioxane boiling point (101°C), despite calculation suggesting it might not be strictly required.
